Radiation Therapy, AAS

Radiation Therapy, AAS

Radiation therapists provide a key component of cancer treatment, and they are in high demand across the United States. Bellevue College’s program is accredited by the Joint Review Committee on Education in Radiologic Technology, and it is the only radiation therapy technology program in Washington State. As a radiation therapist, you’ll have the ability to work in a variety of healthcare settings. Join the radiation therapy program for personalized instruction on the way to a flexible and rewarding career.

          Points of Pride

Professionally Recognized

Accredited by the Joint Review Committee on Education in Radiologic Technology (JRCERT).

          Featured Faculty

          See Radiation Therapy Faculty Page

Linda Schoenfeld

Faculty

Linda Schoenfeld worked for two years as a radiation therapy assistant before becoming a registered radiation therapist since 1978, then a certified medical dosimetrist since 1989. She has been teaching – and serving as the clinical coordinator for the Medical Dosimetry program – at Bellevue College since 2009.

Subramanya K. Betageri

Faculty/Clinical Coordinator

Subramanya “Manya” K. Betageri is a board-certified and registered radiation therapist with 21 years of experience. He is a professor and clinical coordinator for the BC Radiation Therapy Program with over ten years of experience as a radiation therapy educator.
